name: ChengDu Hi-Tech Development Co., Ltd.
summary: ChengDu Hi-Tech Development Co., Ltd., a company based in Chengdu, China, operates a diverse business portfolio. Its activities primarily encompass real estate, construction, futures brokerage, and the manufacturing of kitchen cabinets. The company's real estate division is responsible for managing a variety of properties, including residential complexes, commercial buildings, and specialized science and technology industrial parks. Its construction arm offers comprehensive services, ranging from general building and municipal public works contracting to specialized engineering. These specialized services include foundation work, interior decoration, fire protection system installation, anti-corrosion and thermal insulation, steel structure fabrication, and the installation of electrical and mechanical equipment. Furthermore, ChengDu Hi-Tech Development Co., Ltd. engages in commodity and financial futures trading. It also undertakes the development of industrial parks and oversees hotel operations. Established in 1995, the firm was originally incorporated under the name Chengdu Brilliant Development Group Co., Ltd.
